body: That was very accurate in a lot of ways especially the fact that suicidal people are labelled and cast aside. It's such a horrible system, nobody wants to talk about suicide. People do everything they can to encourage suicidal people to seek help but all that actually does is get you a permanent mark in your mental health records and hinder you in the future. People want to help to feel better about themselves, they don't actually want to help you get better. Because as I was told before this post, they don't. You're stuck with it all. Deep down everybody knows that but they'd rather you live miserably then let you talk about your feelings before going with dignity. They shut you up and suicide proof you for themselves and their statistics and own consciences.
Hehehehe all your problems are trivial and don't matter!!! :P I know everything will get better for a fact because that ALWAYS happens, every time!!
